notes.title: Tower Defense Mode Released
notes.notes:
Hello, hi, how you doin?

We've been silenced for a pretty long time creating promised Tower Defence mode.

Tower Defence offers unending waves of enemies coming from difirent pathes trying to get to the farmers wife. You shall teleport to different spots in order to protect her. In addition, we added a new weapon: double barell shotgun just for that occasion.

Here is a gameplay of the new mode 

https://youtu.be/JxrpqvKjTNE

Update also comes with some bug fixes, if you encounter any errors, please contact us in a steam community or our [url=https://discord.gg/TCTXTCh] Discord[/url]

notes.title: Mad Farm RoadMap
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30274518/1d0eccaeee6660937c1bfb6961e657d0bb2c5450.png[/img]

Considering the feedback we gather after the launch of Mad Farm, we developed a roadmap that we plan to implement into the game in the nearest future.
[list]
[*]First and foremost, we will add steam achievements, and since we like to do hardcore things it will include an insane difficulty challenges and achievements.

[*]We had couple of complains regarding the game content and how it could be enhanced to deliver even a better experience, therefore we decided to bring a tower defense into the game with a free movement system for all of your wondering minds that want to peek behind that hangar.

[*]Yes, graphics will indeed become cooler and we plan to fill those field a little.

[*]Since we are all for the weapon mechanics, we will add two more: a shotgun and a melee weapon hay fork.

[*]We are aware about co-op and multiplayer demand, and that demand shall be fulfilled, however it will happen after this roadmap is complete.
[/list]

notes.title: Mad Farm VR Demo is out!
notes.notes:
We know how frustrating it might be to not be pleased with a content or buy the game to find out that configurations are not running so smoothly on your machine. To avoid all those uncertainties, we decided to add a free demo version of Mad Farm VR so you can play it and see for yourself if it worth a purchase or not and save yourself from the additional headache that comes from somewhat a “blind” purchase.

Mad Farm VR Demo features only training mode where you can test all weapons and mechanics that game offers. We think it is enough to create the first impression and see if our claims of having “Stupidly realistic physics” is correct or not and test the game overall.


Oh, and by the way, the roadmap is coming this week, ohohohohohohoho

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Some bugs were fixed and new features added.

Boss Fight - boss not responding fixed

Added Music Control
Added configuration for left handed people
Added checkpoints in the Story mode. 

To adress early issues in the game, where it was almost unplayable, we want to give our sincere apologies. By mistake we updated with a wrong build which caused so many bugs, issues and so on. Now it all should be fixed.

Thank you everyone for the feedbacks

notes.title: MAD FARM IS OUT
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30274518/1d0eccaeee6660937c1bfb6961e657d0bb2c5450.png[/img][h1]THE DAY HAS COME TO ENJOY MASS SLAUGHTER[/h1]

Mad Farm is finally out! Dive in, explore the different locations, (if you can survive even one) see your wife being eaten by a pig (or not, but the second option of her surviving is obviously boring), feel things explode in your face, get excited seeing a “too big for all this” bear and well, just have fun!

We’ve been developing this game for quite a while, and we were not focusing on a very “unique” esthetics or a “deep to my bones” story. All we wanted to do is bring a very old school arcade type of game, where your brain doesn’t need to be operational while playing it and you can dive right in and have fun without thinking about anything. 

We have plenty of plans for this title and having your feedback and suggestions would be awesome!
We will be posting a guideline to the game (so no one is confused) as well as our development roadmap for the future, in which you can participate.

Thank you all for the support and we hope you will enjoy it as much as we did creating it.

[b]Happy Massacre EVERYBODY![/b]

P.S. By the way, feel free to report bugs and all that, it’s kinda helpful.

notes.title: Mad Farm comes out March 10!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30274518/9f142f58d545a081eb74f0c94663517cdd856c20.png[/img]
[b][h1]The day has come![/h1][/b]

We are glad to announce that Mad Farm will be released and available for Oculus Rift, HTC Vive and MR headsets on Steam on [b]10th of March[/b]. The price of the game is $9.99.

Release version includes three different maps: Farm, Forest and a Boss Fight.

Currently the game will feature three playable modes such as Arcade, Story Mode and Training. Modes will be expanded in the future updates.

This has been an incredible journey for us and to finally announce the release, after so many shift that we did, brings nothing but excitement to our team.

Make sure to stay tuned to our Steam page since we will be posting a lot of materials to give you additional insights into Mad Farm.
Or you can simply join our Discord: https://discord.gg/wHaBmgx

We hope you will enjoy playing game as much as we did by making it!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ElNEuu3OMwg

notes.title: Farm Location is Done!
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohs4BdwhUaDhiohMs/giphy.gif[/img]
[h1]Farm locations in Mad Farm is completely DONE.[/h1]
Farm will feature various steps until you can move on to the next location. Every time you move to the next stage you will be granted with a new weapon, or an option to restock your ammunition. Difficulty will raise as well, however it has its own cap. For all hardcore lovers, there is an arcade mode. Arcades are available for every location featured in the game, however you can unlock it only by completing it (for example, boss fight arcade will unlock only when you defeat the boss in original play). We decided for arcade to feature stage system as well, since relocation makes a new surrounding from where animals can occur. In arcade the difficulty rise is endless, and it affects several things: animal spawn quantity, respawn rate of a wave and damage of animals.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/26DNdDXzw6iHZ1bEY/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
Next step is to prepare Forest and the boss fight but worry not! All that needs to be done is polishing and optimization and boom, it’s ready! Therefore, make sure to check out for updates as we will announce the release date soon. 
Meanwhile you can go and watch some gameplay on YouTube, and don’t forget to add Mad Farm in your Wishlist so you don’t skip anything!

Oh, and please, feel free to share your thoughts with us on Discord:
https://discord.gg/wHaBmgx

Happy massacre everybody!

https://youtu.be/KlOCO4LxJKw

notes.title: First Gameplay Video
notes.notes:
This has been a tough run with a lot of trials and errors, but finally we can announce that Mad Farm is getting closer to its release. 

While we are giving some finishing touches to locations and are polishing the game to deliver the best killing, annihilating and murdering experiences, we are suggesting to check out the gameplay video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KlOCO4LxJKw

Hope you like it and we can't wait to make you pissed trying to hit that chicken with an arrow... or an axe... or whatever.
